name: No mutation
lesson: With mutation switched off, crossover can only reshuffle genes the population already has, so a gene that starts missing stays missing.
lookFor: In this seed no individual starts with a 1 in gene 1. The share of 1s for gene 1 stays at 0 for the whole run, diversity falls to 0 as the population fills with copies of one chromosome, and the run is expected to stall at 225 (01111, x = 15), well short of the optimum 961.
